def drain (x : Std.U64) (y : Std.U64) : Result (Std.U64 × Std.U64) := do
  if x != 0#u64
  then
    let y1 ← lift (core.num.U64.wrapping_add y 1#u64)
    let x1 ← x - 1#u64
    drain x1 y1
  else ok (x, y)
partial_fixpoint

def callers (s : S) : Result S := do
  let (i, i1) ← drain s.a s.b
  let (i2, i3) ← drain s.c s.d
  ok { a := i, b := i1, c := i2, d := i3 }

def callers_swapped (s : S) : Result S := do
  let (i, i1) ← drain s.c s.d
  let (i2, i3) ← drain s.a s.b
  ok { a := i2, b := i3, c := i, d := i1 }
